title: Document Length — 16-Page Ceiling
description: The rendered TR doc must fit within constraints.pages.max (26) pages, target ~23, measured by graders/page_grader.py against the real .docx layout. This is THE content limit: recording time is paced per slide (1.5 min each) and so is spent by the slide count, while the amount of text is what consumes pages. The ceiling scales with the slide ceiling — a slide costs ~0.887 rendered pages (median over every generated doc), so 26 slides is ~23 pages.
criterion: Estimated pages <= 26. At or under the 23-page target scores 5; 24-26 is acceptable but tight; over 26 fails. A doc far short of the target is flagged only if the shortfall came from dropping sub-concepts rather than from a genuinely small syllabus line.

rubric.5: <= 23 pages — inside the target, with room for a revision pass.
rubric.3: 24-26 pages — within the ceiling but with no margin.
rubric.1: > 26 pages (over the ceiling), or so short that coverage was probably dropped.

cases.rationale: 21 pages over 24 slides — inside the 23-page target, length spent on coverage.
31 pages over the 26-page ceiling, and pages_by_part shows analogies and speaker notes carrying it — padded, not earned.
